source.implements: Import (the sheet): a refused export (or one resolve cannot read) lists every message, one per line, and nothing is kept; an imported one is kept on the phone as the export (resolved again at every start, each in a try: one that cannot be read is listed as out of date), gets an id no list has, and opens; if the phone cannot keep it, the toast says so
an imported list's Overview ends with where it came from, whether this phone keeps it, and Remove this list (a confirm on the page: Remove / Keep it)
Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks and its Phase checklist boxes), the app goes to the home screen
